newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKMA to step up supervision with Macau counterpart.
newsitem.headline: HKMA to step up supervision with Macau counterpart.

text.p: The Hong Kong government said on Wednesday that the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) has signed a memorandum of understanding with its Macau counterpart to strengthen supervisory co-operation between them.

The agreement with the Autoridade Monetaria e Cambial de Macau (AMCM) sets out the framework for co-ordinating supervision of branches, representative offices and subsidiaries of financial institutions from each other's territory.
Both parties also agreed to continue close consultation and co-operation between them, it said in a statement.

"I am confident that the signing of the MOU between the HKMA and the AMCM will enable the two regulatory authorities to work closely together to enhance cross-border supervision of financial institutions in Hong Kong and Macau," HKMA chief executive Joseph Yam said in the statement.
